newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-BAILEY TO MEET CHRISTIE OVER 150 METRES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BAILEY TO MEET CHRISTIE OVER 150 METRES.

text.p: Olympic 100 metres champion Donovan Bailey will meet Britain's former gold medallist Linford Christie over 150 metres in Sheffield on June 29.
The winner will earn 50,000 pounds sterling ($81,000).
Canadian Bailey picked up $1.5 million after beating American Olympic 200 champion Michael Johnson over the same distance in Toronto on Sunday.
Johnson pulled up 30 metres from the line after pulling his left quadriceps and has since withdrawn from the U.S. championships.
"I am happy to compete in the 150 metres in what I have come to think of as the home of 150 metres running in front of an enthusiastic and knowledgeable Sheffield crowd," Christie said on Friday.
Christie, 37, won the Olympic title in Barcelona five years ago. He will captain Britain in the European Cup in Munich this month but has said he will not run at the Athens world championships.
